output.summary: Require a coherent worktree capture spanning enumeration, reads and sealing, with invalidation on relevant mutations or observation loss. Test concurrent edits, additions, renames, edit-and-revert and lost observation so synthetic snapshots cannot validate a target.
Both design reviews approve the revision. The prior material finding on coherent worktree capture is resolved, and no open findings or notes require verdicts.

findings.impact: A later run could falsely validate a synthetic or incomplete target while omitting changes that existed during capture.
findings.text: The design protects inputs during execution but leaves enumeration and capture unprotected. A file read early can change, or a relevant file can appear after enumeration, producing a fingerprint for a mixed or incomplete tree that never represented the requested worktree. Specify point-in-time capture or reliable observation/serialization of enumeration and reads with invalidation/retry on mutation or lost observation, and test concurrent file changes, additions and edit-and-revert during capture.
